title: Replacement Deposit on a Deposit Pre-Order — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Calculation Clauses
content:
**R1. Price the deposit rests on.** The deposit on a replacement is not worked out until the reservation it replaces carries its protected reserved price as its reserved unit price. The replacement carries that reserved unit price and the units of the reservation it replaces. Until the reservation replaced shows its protected reserved price as its reserved unit price, no replacement deposit is worked out on it.

**R2. Amount.** The deposit on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order replacement is its reserved unit price times its units times the replacement deposit percentage, divided by 100. The replacement deposit percentage is the deposit percentage of the Deposit Pre-Order type, its standard replacement deposit percentage.

**R3. Floor and rounding.** The replacement deposit is never less than the Deposit Pre-Order type's minimum deposit, and the floor applies last. The deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**R4. Charge.** The replacement deposit is charged to the card at reservation.

**Worked examples.** These use hypothetical replacements. The Deposit Pre-Order type figures used are 20 percent, with a $25.00 minimum.

| Reserved unit price | Units | Price times 20, divided by 100 | Floor applied | Deposit charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $350.00 | 1 | $70.00 | $70.00 | $70.00 |
| $110.00 | 1 | $22.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 |
| $189.99 | 2 | $75.996 | $75.996 | $76.00 |
